verify.name: mutation-monotone_validation_too_few_pr
verify.cmd: f=crates/core/src/dsp/envelope.rs; b=$(mktemp); cp "$f" "$b"; trap 'cp "$b" "$f"; rm -f "$b"' EXIT; sed -i 's#if points.len() < 2 {#if points.len() < 1 {#' "$f"; if cmp -s "$f" "$b"; then echo "MUTATION NOT APPLIED"; exit 1; fi; out=$(qcargo test -p wavcraft-core monotone_validation_too_few_precedes_nonfinite 2>&1); echo "$out" | grep -E "^test result:" ; echo "$out" | grep -E "test result: FAILED[.] 0 passed; 1 failed"

verify.name: mutation-monotone_validation_nonfinite_
verify.cmd: f=crates/core/src/dsp/envelope.rs; b=$(mktemp); cp "$f" "$b"; trap 'cp "$b" "$f"; rm -f "$b"' EXIT; sed -i 's#if points.iter().any(|&(t, g)| !t.is_finite() || !g.is_finite()) {#if false \&\& points.iter().any(|\&(t, g)| !t.is_finite() || !g.is_finite()) {#' "$f"; if cmp -s "$f" "$b"; then echo "MUTATION NOT APPLIED"; exit 1; fi; out=$(qcargo test -p wavcraft-core monotone_validation_nonfinite_precedes_not_increasing 2>&1); echo "$out" | grep -E "^test result:" ; echo "$out" | grep -E "test result: FAILED[.] 0 passed; 1 failed"
